top_signals.title: Australian Dollar Erases 2026 Gain as Rate-Cut Bets Increase
top_signals.summary: Australia’s dollar wiped out its 2026 gain against the greenback after weak employment data reinforced bets that the central bank has ended its interest-rate hike cycle and will pivot to cuts next year.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: How does EIA account for small differences between energy supply and demand data?
top_signals.summary: EIA uses over 60 surveys to collect data on the U.S. energy sector's supply and demand. In theory, supply and demand should balance. In practice, we often have small differences between our total supply and total demand figures.
